declarations.name: closedUpper
declarations.header: def closedUpper (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
declarations.full_definition:
def closedUpper (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if s ≤ 2 then A / s else suzukiContinuousUpperFactor s

declarations.name: upper_initial
declarations.header:
theorem upper_initial {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) (hs3 : s ≤ 3) :
    suzukiContinuousUpperFactor s = A / s :=

declarations.name: closedUpper_eq_actual
declarations.header:
theorem closedUpper_eq_actual {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    closedUpper s = suzukiContinuousUpperFactor s :=

declarations.name: closedUpper_one
declarations.header: @[simp] theorem closedUpper_one : closedUpper 1 = A :=

declarations.name: continuousOn_closedUpper
declarations.header: theorem continuousOn_closedUpper : ContinuousOn closedUpper (Ici 1) :=

declarations.name: tendsto_closedUpper_one
declarations.header:
theorem tendsto_closedUpper_one :
    Tendsto closedUpper (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 A) :=

declarations.name: tendsto_actualUpper_one
declarations.header:
theorem tendsto_actualUpper_one :
    Tendsto suzukiContinuousUpperFactor (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 A) :=

declarations.name: tendsto_actualUpper_div_one
declarations.header:
theorem tendsto_actualUpper_div_one (u : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => suzukiContinuousUpperFactor s / u)
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (A / u)) :=

declarations.name: normalization
declarations.header:
theorem normalization :
    (2 * Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant)) * A = 4 :=

declarations.name: closedUpper_nonneg
declarations.header: theorem closedUpper_nonneg {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 ≤ s) : 0 ≤ closedUpper s :=

declarations.name: closedUpper_le_amplitude
declarations.header: theorem closedUpper_le_amplitude {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 ≤ s) : closedUpper s ≤ A :=

declarations.name: residual
declarations.header: def residual (lambda : ℝ) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ :=

declarations.name: normalized
declarations.header: def normalized (lambda : ℝ) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
declarations.full_definition:
def normalized (lambda : ℝ) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  closedUpper (residual lambda t) / t (Fin.last 3)

declarations.name: density
declarations.header: def density (lambda : ℝ) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
declarations.full_definition:
def density (lambda : ℝ) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant)) * normalized lambda t

declarations.name: legal
declarations.header: def legal (a lambda : ℝ) : Set (Fin 4 → ℝ) :=
declarations.full_definition:
def legal (a lambda : ℝ) : Set (Fin 4 → ℝ) :=
  {t | a ≤ t (Fin.last 3) ∧ (∑ i, t i) + t (Fin.last 3) ≤ lambda}

declarations.name: isClosed_legal
declarations.header: theorem isClosed_legal (a lambda : ℝ) : IsClosed (legal a lambda) :=

declarations.name: residual_one_le
declarations.header:
theorem residual_one_le {a lambda : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {t : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ legal a lambda) : 1 ≤ residual lambda t :=

declarations.name: continuousOn_normalized
declarations.header:
theorem continuousOn_normalized {a lambda : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ContinuousOn (normalized lambda) (legal a lambda) :=

declarations.name: continuousOn_density
declarations.header:
theorem continuousOn_density {a lambda : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ContinuousOn (density lambda) (legal a lambda) :=

declarations.name: abs_normalized_le
declarations.header:
theorem abs_normalized_le {a lambda : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {t : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ legal a lambda) : |normalized lambda t| ≤ A / a :=

declarations.name: abs_density_le
declarations.header:
theorem abs_density_le {a lambda : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {t : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ legal a lambda) : |density lambda t| ≤ 4 / a :=

declarations.name: normalized_eq_actual
declarations.header:
theorem normalized_eq_actual (lambda : ℝ) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (hs : 1 < residual lambda t) :
    normalized lambda t =
      suzukiContinuousUpperFactor ((lambda - ∑ i, t i) / t (Fin.last 3)) /
        t (Fin.last 3) :=

declarations.name: density_eq_actual
declarations.header:
theorem density_eq_actual (lambda : ℝ) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (hs : 1 < residual lambda t) :
    density lambda t =
      (2 * Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / t (Fin.last 3)) *
        suzukiContinuousUpperFactor ((lambda - ∑ i, t i) / t (Fin.last 3)) :=

declarations.name: normalized_at_wall
declarations.header:
theorem normalized_at_wall {lambda : ℝ} {t : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hwall : residual lambda t = 1) : normalized lambda t = A / t (Fin.last 3) :=

declarations.name: density_at_wall
declarations.header:
theorem density_at_wall {lambda : ℝ} {t : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hwall : residual lambda t = 1) : density lambda t = 4 / t (Fin.last 3) :=

declarations.name: integrableOn_normalized_compact
declarations.header:
theorem integrableOn_normalized_compact {a lambda : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    {K : Set (Fin 4 → ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hlegal : K ⊆ legal a lambda) :
    IntegrableOn (normalized lambda) K :=

declarations.name: integrableOn_density_compact
declarations.header:
theorem integrableOn_density_compact {a lambda : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    {K : Set (Fin 4 → ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hlegal : K ⊆ legal a lambda) :
    IntegrableOn (density lambda) K :=

declarations.name: integrableOn_density_legalBox
declarations.header:
theorem integrableOn_density_legalBox {a b lambda : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    IntegrableOn (density lambda)
      (univ.pi (fun _ : Fin 4 => Icc a b) ∩ legal a lambda) :=

declarations.name: maxOneNormalized
declarations.header: def maxOneNormalized (lambda : ℝ) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
declarations.full_definition:
def maxOneNormalized (lambda : ℝ) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  closedUpper (max 1 (residual lambda t)) / t (Fin.last 3)

declarations.name: maxOneNormalized_eq
declarations.header:
theorem maxOneNormalized_eq {a lambda : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {t : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ legal a lambda) : maxOneNormalized lambda t = normalized lambda t :=

declarations.name: continuousOn_maxOneNormalized
declarations.header:
theorem continuousOn_maxOneNormalized {a b lambda : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ContinuousOn (maxOneNormalized lambda)
      (univ.pi (fun _ : Fin 4 => Icc a b)) :=

declarations.name: integrableOn_maxOneNormalized
declarations.header:
theorem integrableOn_maxOneNormalized {a b lambda : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    IntegrableOn (maxOneNormalized lambda)
      (univ.pi (fun _ : Fin 4 => Icc a b)) :=

declarations.name: first_coordinate_ancestor_one
declarations.header:
theorem first_coordinate_ancestor_one (N : ℝ) (history : List ℕ)
    (hlen : 1 ≤ history.length) :
    primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 1 (rosserAncestor 1 history) 0 =
      primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history 0 :=

declarations.name: firstStop_first_coordinate_bound
declarations.header:
theorem firstStop_first_coordinate_bound (e : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (N : ℝ)
    (history : List ℕ) (hlen : 1 ≤ history.length)
    (hstop : firstStop e m N (rosserAncestor 1 history)) :
    primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history 0 ≤ extendedFirstStop - 4 * e :=

declarations.name: initial_first_exponent_reserve
declarations.header:
theorem initial_first_exponent_reserve (e : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (N : ℝ)
    (history : List ℕ) (hlen : 1 ≤ history.length)
    (hstop : firstStop e m N (rosserAncestor 1 history)) :
    17 / 4000 + 10 * e ≤ initial e -
      3 * primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history 0 :=

declarations.name: initial_first_exponent_strict
declarations.header:
theorem initial_first_exponent_strict (e : ℝ) (he : 0 < e) (m : ℕ) (N : ℝ)
    (history : List ℕ) (hlen : 1 ≤ history.length)
    (hstop : firstStop e m N (rosserAncestor 1 history)) :
    3 * primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history 0 < initial e :=

declarations.name: effectiveExponent
declarations.header: def effectiveExponent (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega N : ℝ) (history : List ℕ) : ℝ :=
declarations.full_definition:
def effectiveExponent (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega N : ℝ) (history : List ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if supported e chi m omega N history then
    exponent e chi m (primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history)
  else initial e

declarations.name: rawLevel_eq_rpow_effectiveExponent
declarations.header:
theorem rawLevel_eq_rpow_effectiveExponent (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega N : ℝ)
    (history : List ℕ) :
    rawLevel e chi m omega N history = N ^ effectiveExponent e chi m omega N history :=

declarations.name: selected_first_exponent_strict
declarations.header:
theorem selected_first_exponent_strict (e chi : ℝ)
    (he : 0 < e) (hesmall : e < (3 / 256 : ℝ) / 100) (hchi : chi < e / 10)
    (m : ℕ) (N : ℝ) (history : List ℕ) (j : Cell m)
    (hj : j ∈ cells e chi m)
    (ht : primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history ∈ logPrimeMeshCell 0 (19 / 96) m j) :
    3 * primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history 0 <
      exponent e chi m (primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history) :=

declarations.name: effective_first_exponent_strict
declarations.header:
theorem effective_first_exponent_strict (e chi : ℝ)
    (he : 0 < e) (hesmall : e < (3 / 256 : ℝ) / 100) (hchi : chi < e / 10)
    (m : ℕ) (omega N : ℝ) (history : List ℕ) (hlen : 1 ≤ history.length)
    (hstop : firstStop e m N (rosserAncestor 1 history)) :
    3 * primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history 0 <
      effectiveExponent e chi m omega N history :=

declarations.name: rpow_first_coordinate
declarations.header:
theorem rpow_first_coordinate (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N) (history : List ℕ)
    (hp : 0 < primeHistoryTuple 1 history 0) :
    N ^ primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history 0 =
      (primeHistoryTuple 1 history 0 : ℝ) :=

declarations.name: rawLevel_first_prime_cube
declarations.header:
theorem rawLevel_first_prime_cube (e chi : ℝ)
    (he : 0 < e) (hesmall : e < (3 / 256 : ℝ) / 100) (hchi : chi < e / 10)
    (m : ℕ) (omega N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N) (history : List ℕ)
    (hlen : 1 ≤ history.length) (hp : 0 < primeHistoryTuple 1 history 0)
    (hstop : firstStop e m N (rosserAncestor 1 history)) :
    (primeHistoryTuple 1 history 0 : ℝ) ^ 3 < rawLevel e chi m omega N history :=

declarations.name: fallback_first_prime_cube
declarations.header:
theorem fallback_first_prime_cube (e chi : ℝ) (he : 0 < e)
    (m : ℕ) (omega N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N) (history : List ℕ)
    (hlen : 1 ≤ history.length) (hp : 0 < primeHistoryTuple 1 history 0)
    (hstop : firstStop e m N (rosserAncestor 1 history))
    (hs : ¬ supported e chi m omega N history) :
    (primeHistoryTuple 1 history 0 : ℝ) ^ 3 < rawLevel e chi m omega N history :=

declarations.name: outside_first_prime_cube
declarations.header:
theorem outside_first_prime_cube (e chi : ℝ) (he : 0 < e)
    (m : ℕ) (omega N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N) (history : List ℕ)
    (hlen : 1 ≤ history.length) (hp : 0 < primeHistoryTuple 1 history 0)
    (hstop : firstStop e m N (rosserAncestor 1 history))
    (hout : ∀ j ∈ cells e chi m,
      primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history ∉ logPrimeMeshCell 0 (19 / 96) m j) :
    (primeHistoryTuple 1 history 0 : ℝ) ^ 3 < rawLevel e chi m omega N history :=

declarations.name: first_coordinate_ancestor_three
declarations.header:
theorem first_coordinate_ancestor_three (N : ℝ) (history : List ℕ)
    (hlen : 3 ≤ history.length) :
    primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 (rosserAncestor 3 history) 0 =
      primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history 0 :=

declarations.name: first_integer_ancestor_three
declarations.header:
theorem first_integer_ancestor_three (history : List ℕ) (hlen : 3 ≤ history.length) :
    primeHistoryTuple 1 (rosserAncestor 3 history) 0 = primeHistoryTuple 1 history 0 :=

declarations.name: frozen_first_exponent_strict
declarations.header:
theorem frozen_first_exponent_strict (e chi : ℝ)
    (he : 0 < e) (hesmall : e < (3 / 256 : ℝ) / 100) (hchi : chi < e / 10)
    (m : ℕ) (omega N : ℝ) (history : List ℕ) (hlen : 3 ≤ history.length)
    (hstop : firstStop e m N (rosserAncestor 1 history)) :
    3 * primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history 0 <
      effectiveExponent e chi m omega N (rosserAncestor 3 history) :=

declarations.name: frozenLevel_first_prime_cube
declarations.header:
theorem frozenLevel_first_prime_cube (e chi : ℝ)
    (he : 0 < e) (hesmall : e < (3 / 256 : ℝ) / 100) (hchi : chi < e / 10)
    (m : ℕ) (omega N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N) (history : List ℕ)
    (hlen : 3 ≤ history.length) (hp : 0 < primeHistoryTuple 1 history 0)
    (hstop : firstStop e m N (rosserAncestor 1 history)) :
    (primeHistoryTuple 1 history 0 : ℝ) ^ 3 < frozenLevel e chi m omega N history :=

declarations.name: actual_frontier_first_exponent_margins
declarations.header:
theorem actual_frontier_first_exponent_margins (e chi : ℝ)
    (he : 0 < e) (hesmall : e < (3 / 256 : ℝ) / 100) (hchi : chi < e / 10)
    (m : ℕ) (omega N : ℝ) (weight : ℕ → ℝ) (carrier : List ℕ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (state : FirstExitDepthState ℕ)
    (hstate : state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier k (policy e chi m omega N)
      weight [] true 1 carrier) :
    (17 / 4000 + 10 * e ≤ initial e -
      3 * primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 state.selectedPrefix 0) ∧
    (3 * primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 state.selectedPrefix 0 <
      effectiveExponent e chi m omega N (rosserAncestor 3 state.selectedPrefix)) :=

declarations.name: actual_frontier_initial_and_frozen_first_cube
declarations.header:
theorem actual_frontier_initial_and_frozen_first_cube (e chi : ℝ)
    (he : 0 < e) (hesmall : e < (3 / 256 : ℝ) / 100) (hchi : chi < e / 10)
    (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N cap : ℕ) (hN : 1 < (N : ℝ)) (w z : ℝ)
    (weight : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (state : FirstExitDepthState ℕ)
    (hstate : state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier k (policy e chi m omega (N : ℝ))
      weight [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z)) :
    firstStop e m (N : ℝ) (rosserAncestor 1 state.selectedPrefix) ∧
      (primeHistoryTuple 1 state.selectedPrefix 0 : ℝ) ^ 3 < (N : ℝ) ^ initial e ∧
      (primeHistoryTuple 1 state.selectedPrefix 0 : ℝ) ^ 3 <
        frozenLevel e chi m omega (N : ℝ) state.selectedPrefix :=

declarations.name: actual_next_candidate_initial_and_frozen_first_cube
declarations.header:
theorem actual_next_candidate_initial_and_frozen_first_cube (e chi : ℝ)
    (he : 0 < e) (hesmall : e < (3 / 256 : ℝ) / 100) (hchi : chi < e / 10)
    (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N cap : ℕ) (hN : 1 < (N : ℝ)) (z : ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (frontier candidate : FirstExitDepthState ℕ)
    (hfrontier : frontier ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier k (policy e chi m omega (N : ℝ))
      (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z))
    (hcandidate : candidate ∈ firstExitNextSelectionCandidates
      (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) frontier.selectedPrefix
      frontier.positive frontier.mass frontier.remaining) :
    firstStop e m (N : ℝ) (rosserAncestor 1 candidate.selectedPrefix) ∧
      (primeHistoryTuple 1 candidate.selectedPrefix 0 : ℝ) ^ 3 < (N : ℝ) ^ initial e ∧
      (primeHistoryTuple 1 candidate.selectedPrefix 0 : ℝ) ^ 3 <
        frozenLevel e chi m omega (N : ℝ) candidate.selectedPrefix :=

declarations.name: wallForm
declarations.header: def wallForm : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
declarations.full_definition:
def wallForm : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.proj 0 : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) +
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj 1 : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) +
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj 2 : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) +
    (2 : ℝ) • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj 3 : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)

declarations.name: wallForm_eq_sum_last
declarations.header:
theorem wallForm_eq_sum_last (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    wallForm t = (∑ i, t i) + t 3 :=

declarations.name: wallForm_ne_zero
declarations.header: theorem wallForm_ne_zero : wallForm ≠ 0 :=

declarations.name: rawTupleLevel
declarations.header: def rawTupleLevel (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (p : Fin 4 → ℕ) : ℝ :=
declarations.full_definition:
def rawTupleLevel (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (p : Fin 4 → ℕ) : ℝ :=
  rawLevel e chi m omega (N : ℝ) (HistoricalThirdCoarse.P1OriginalFourth.history3 p)

declarations.name: rawTupleExponent
declarations.header:
def rawTupleExponent (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N : ℕ)
    (p : Fin 4 → ℕ) : ℝ :=

declarations.name: rawTupleGap
declarations.header: def rawTupleGap (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (p : Fin 4 → ℕ) : ℝ :=
declarations.full_definition:
def rawTupleGap (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (p : Fin 4 → ℕ) : ℝ :=
  rawTupleExponent e chi m omega N p - (∑ i, actualPrimeTupleLog N p i) -
    actualPrimeTupleLog N p 3

/-- An actual raw-level equality fixes its logarithmic exponent exactly. -/

declarations.name: rawTupleExponent_eq_of_level
declarations.header:
theorem rawTupleExponent_eq_of_level {e chi omega lambda : ℝ} {m N : ℕ}
    (hN : 1 < N) (p : Fin 4 → ℕ)
    (hlevel : rawTupleLevel e chi m omega N p = (N : ℝ) ^ lambda) :
    rawTupleExponent e chi m omega N p = lambda :=

declarations.name: rawTupleExponent_mem_values
declarations.header:
theorem rawTupleExponent_mem_values (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 < N) (p : Fin 4 → ℕ) :
    rawTupleExponent e chi m omega N p ∈
      P1ActualCoarseLevelCeiling.exponentValues e chi m :=

declarations.name: rawTupleGap_eq_quotientLogGap
declarations.header:
theorem rawTupleGap_eq_quotientLogGap
    (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 < N)
    (p : Fin 4 → ℕ) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < p i) :
    rawTupleGap e chi m omega N p =
      Real.log (rawTupleLevel e chi m omega N p / (∏ i, p i : ℕ)) /
        Real.log (N : ℝ) - actualPrimeTupleLog N p 3 :=

declarations.name: originalAdmittedTuples
declarations.header:
def originalAdmittedTuples (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ)
    (N cap : ℕ) (b : ℝ) : Finset (Fin 4 → ℕ) :=
declarations.full_definition:
def originalAdmittedTuples (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ)
    (N cap : ℕ) (b : ℝ) : Finset (Fin 4 → ℕ) :=
  firstExitAdmittedTuples 4 (policy e chi m omega (N : ℝ))
    (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 ((N : ℝ) ^ b))

/-- Original carrier with an explicit positive-power last-prime cutoff. -/

declarations.name: originalWallTuples
declarations.header:
def originalWallTuples (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ)
    (N cap : ℕ) (a b delta : ℝ) : Finset (Fin 4 → ℕ) :=
declarations.full_definition:
def originalWallTuples (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ)
    (N cap : ℕ) (a b delta : ℝ) : Finset (Fin 4 → ℕ) :=
  (originalAdmittedTuples e chi m omega N cap b).filter fun p =>
    (N : ℝ) ^ a ≤ (p (Fin.last 3) : ℝ) ∧
      0 < rawTupleGap e chi m omega N p ∧ rawTupleGap e chi m omega N p ≤ delta

/-- Strict decreasing order lifts the last-prime lower cutoff to every coordinate. -/

declarations.name: original_admitted_mem_cube
declarations.header:
theorem original_admitted_mem_cube
    (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N cap : ℕ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hcap : (N : ℝ) ^ b ≤ (cap : ℝ)) (p : Fin 4 → ℕ)
    (hp : p ∈ originalAdmittedTuples e chi m omega N cap b)
    (hlast : (N : ℝ) ^ a ≤ (p (Fin.last 3) : ℝ)) :
    p ∈ actualPrimeBoxTuples N (fun _ : Fin 4 => a) (fun _ => b) :=

declarations.name: original_admitted_gap_pos
declarations.header:
theorem original_admitted_gap_pos
    (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N cap : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N)
    (hcap : (N : ℝ) ^ b ≤ (cap : ℝ)) (p : Fin 4 → ℕ)
    (hp : p ∈ originalAdmittedTuples e chi m omega N cap b) :
    0 < rawTupleGap e chi m omega N p :=

declarations.name: WallIndex
declarations.header: abbrev WallIndex (values : Finset ℝ) :=
declarations.full_definition: abbrev WallIndex (values : Finset ℝ) := Fin (Fintype.card {x : ℝ // x ∈ values})

declarations.name: finiteWallForms
declarations.header: def finiteWallForms (values : Finset ℝ) : WallIndex values → (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
declarations.full_definition:
def finiteWallForms (values : Finset ℝ) : WallIndex values → (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  fun _ => wallForm

declarations.name: finiteWallBounds
declarations.header: def finiteWallBounds (values : Finset ℝ) (i : WallIndex values) : ℝ :=
declarations.full_definition:
def finiteWallBounds (values : Finset ℝ) (i : WallIndex values) : ℝ :=
  ((Fintype.equivFin {x : ℝ // x ∈ values}).symm i).val

declarations.name: finiteWallForms_ne_zero
declarations.header: theorem finiteWallForms_ne_zero (values : Finset ℝ) : ∀ i, finiteWallForms values i ≠ 0 :=

declarations.name: scalar_gap_mem_public
declarations.header:
theorem scalar_gap_mem_public {values : Finset ℝ} {lambda delta : ℝ}
    (hlambda : lambda ∈ values) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (hpos : 0 < lambda - (∑ i, t i) - t 3)
    (hsmall : lambda - (∑ i, t i) - t 3 ≤ delta) :
    t ∈ primeAffineWallStrip (finiteWallForms values) (finiteWallBounds values) delta :=

declarations.name: originalWallTuples_subset_public
declarations.header:
theorem originalWallTuples_subset_public
    (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N cap : ℕ) (a b delta delta' : ℝ)
    (hN : 1 < N) (hcap : (N : ℝ) ^ b ≤ (cap : ℝ)) (hdelta : delta ≤ delta') :
    originalWallTuples e chi m omega N cap a b delta ⊆
      (actualPrimeBoxTuples N (fun _ : Fin 4 => a) (fun _ => b)).filter fun p =>
        actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ primeAffineWallStrip
          (finiteWallForms (P1ActualCoarseLevelCeiling.exponentValues e chi m))
          (finiteWallBounds (P1ActualCoarseLevelCeiling.exponentValues e chi m)) delta' :=

declarations.name: signedTupleWeight
declarations.header: def signedTupleWeight (p : Fin 4 → ℕ) : ℝ :=

declarations.name: signedTupleWeight_eq
declarations.header:
theorem signedTupleWeight_eq (p : Fin 4 → ℕ) :
    signedTupleWeight p = ∏ i, 1 / ((p i : ℝ) - 1) :=

declarations.name: signedTupleWeight_history
declarations.header:
theorem signedTupleWeight_history (history : List ℕ) (hlen : history.length = 4) :
    signedTupleWeight (primeHistoryTuple 4 history) =
      signedTreeCoefficient (evenListLength history)
        ((history.map (fun q : ℕ => 1 / ((q : ℝ) - 1))).prod) :=

declarations.name: originalSignedWallMass
declarations.header:
def originalSignedWallMass (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ)
    (N cap : ℕ) (a b delta : ℝ) : ℝ :=
declarations.full_definition:
def originalSignedWallMass (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ)
    (N cap : ℕ) (a b delta : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ p ∈ originalWallTuples e chi m omega N cap a b delta, signedTupleWeight p

/-- The absolute signed mass uses exactly the same actual product weights. -/

declarations.name: originalSignedWallMass_eq_abs_sum
declarations.header:
theorem originalSignedWallMass_eq_abs_sum
    (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N cap : ℕ) (a b delta : ℝ)
    (hcap : (N : ℝ) ^ b ≤ (cap : ℝ)) :
    originalSignedWallMass e chi m omega N cap a b delta =
      ∑ p ∈ originalWallTuples e chi m omega N cap a b delta, |signedTupleWeight p| :=

declarations.name: originalSignedWallMass_le_public
declarations.header:
theorem originalSignedWallMass_le_public
    (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (N cap : ℕ) (a b delta delta' : ℝ)
    (hN : 1 < N) (hcap : (N : ℝ) ^ b ≤ (cap : ℝ)) (hdelta : delta ≤ delta') :
    |originalSignedWallMass e chi m omega N cap a b delta| ≤
      actualPrimeAffineWallStripMass N (fun _ : Fin 4 => a) (fun _ => b)
        (finiteWallForms (P1ActualCoarseLevelCeiling.exponentValues e chi m))
        (finiteWallBounds (P1ActualCoarseLevelCeiling.exponentValues e chi m)) delta' :=

declarations.name: exists_originalSignedWallMass_small_widths_lt
declarations.header:
theorem exists_originalSignedWallMass_small_widths_lt
    (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (eta : ℝ) (heta : 0 < eta) :
    ∃ delta₀ : ℝ, 0 < delta₀ ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ N₀ ∧
      ∀ N cap : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → (N : ℝ) ^ b ≤ (cap : ℝ) →
        ∀ omega delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → delta ≤ delta₀ →
          |originalSignedWallMass e chi m omega N cap a b delta| < eta ∧
          (∑ p ∈ originalWallTuples e chi m omega N cap a b delta,
            |signedTupleWeight p|) < eta :=

declarations.name: exists_originalSignedWallMass_manuscript_upper_lt
declarations.header:
theorem exists_originalSignedWallMass_manuscript_upper_lt
    (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < (19 / 96 : ℝ))
    (eta : ℝ) (heta : 0 < eta) :
    ∃ delta₀ : ℝ, 0 < delta₀ ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ N₀ ∧
      ∀ N cap : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → (N : ℝ) ^ (19 / 96 : ℝ) ≤ (cap : ℝ) →
        ∀ omega delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → delta ≤ delta₀ →
          |originalSignedWallMass e chi m omega N cap a (19 / 96) delta| < eta ∧
          (∑ p ∈ originalWallTuples e chi m omega N cap a (19 / 96) delta,
            |signedTupleWeight p|) < eta :=
